description: 1.8" 128 x 160 colour TFT module (ST7735S), SPI, on a 1x8 female header along its bottom edge: VCC GND CS RESET A0 SDA SCK LED; courtyard the 34.5 x 58 mm module lying over the board (its SD card header not used)

pins.name: LED
pins.description: backlight on when high (tie to 3.3 V if not dimmed)

notes: SPI: SDA to MOSI, SCK to SCK, CS, RESET and A0 (DC) to GPIOs. Logic 3.3 V TTL (5 V controllers need level shifting).
LED high turns the backlight on: PWM it from a GPIO for brightness, or tie it to 3.3 V.
